subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What evidence should OpenClaw require before automatically relinking a corrupted Dashboard key to a preserved transcript or trajectory file?
rationale: The code path needing repair is clear, but choosing an orphan file is a product and data-safety policy decision because the wrong relink would mis-associate user history.

options.title: Require Fixture-Backed Diagnostic
options.body: Keep the issue open until a redacted corrupted store/transcript fixture proves a deterministic validation rule for safe relinking.

options.title: Manual-Only Recovery
options.body: Document a support workflow for inspecting and repairing affected stores without adding automatic relinking behavior.

options.title: Prevent Future Drift Only
options.body: Fix future writes and leave already-corrupted historical mappings for manual recovery, accepting that this report remains only partially addressed.

recommendation.title: Require Fixture-Backed Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a redacted corrupted store/transcript fixture proves a deterministic validation rule for safe relinking.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent transcript-reader identity work makes this the closest current owner path for defining a safe read/repair contract.
